gen.title: Balanced and Unbalanced Forces in Flight

cards.stem: What does the page say happens when forces on an aircraft become unbalanced?
options: move in the direction of the greater force
cards.quote: If the forces become unbalanced, the aircraft will move in the direction of the greater force.
cards.hint: Think about the direction of the net effect.

cards.stem: If weight is decreased while lift is held constant, what result is described?
If lift is decreased while weight stays constant, what result is described?
cards.hint: Consider which vertical force is greater.

cards.stem: When thrust is increased while drag stays constant, what outcome is stated?
cards.hint: Focus on forward versus resistive force.
